# Deepak Jha — dpkay.com

> Full-Stack Architect & Product Builder with 9+ years of industry experience, building web apps since 2014.

## Highlights

- 9+ years in industry (since 2017); building web apps since 2014
- 15+ products shipped: 4 Google Play apps, 10 npm packages, 1 VS Code extension, 3 desktop/CLI tools
- 11 open-source repositories (MIT / Apache-2.0)
- 20K+ users across Google Play, npm, GitHub Releases and VS Code Marketplace

## About

Deepak Jha specializes in distributed systems, real-time platforms, and cloud-native architecture. He has designed and shipped high-availability infrastructure serving thousands of concurrent users across multiple regions — in domains spanning IoT, enterprise security, and retail. Based in India, collaborating with teams globally.
